_note: RECONSTRUCTED 12 August 2026, and not the catalogue that produced the recorded gate numbers for this library. The originals were never committed, which is why those numbers stay RECORDED_RUN. This file makes the gate runnable on requests so a reader with a key can produce a reproducible figure; a run against it is a new experiment with its own date, not a replication of the old one.

patterns.name: http-verb-shortcut
patterns.description: the module-level verb helpers (get, options, head, post, put, patch, delete) that each build a method string and delegate to request(); their bodies are near-identical because the public API is deliberately symmetric, and collapsing them would remove the documented surface

patterns.name: session-verb-shortcut
patterns.description: the same symmetry on Session: per-verb methods that set the method and call Session.request()

patterns.name: hook-dispatch
patterns.description: the small dispatch helpers that iterate registered hooks; repeated shape, one sanctioned mechanism
